correctness.rationale: The real pointwise identity follows by exact quartic coefficient matching with E²=tau²(1+2tau²)(2+tau²), B=3tau²+E>0 and lambda>0. Integrating is valid by Holder in arbitrary L4. The null cone of A(f²−g²)+Bfg consists of two perpendicular rays/lines, and both fourth-norm unit equations uniquely determine the mass in each nonzero branch. At tau=1 equality is disjoint supports. Orthogonal diagonalization of the traceless 2x2 quadratic shows distance^4 to the pointwise null cone <= q(f,g)^2/(B²+4A²); the two-disjoint-band normalized eigenvector construction attains the B/(B²+4A²) coefficient in every real L4 dimension>=2. Independently checked the exact scalar identity and masses symbolically. The bound is NOT distance to globally normalized minimizers.
